_meta.rule: PRE_REGISTRATION.md section 4; hand-classified, one row per distinct name, no default bucket

_ANCHOR_VERDICT.reason: the VALUE is a boolean verdict ('LIVE iff L1 or L2 moved the output off baseline'), not a value written into the encoding. 50 of 94 groups nevertheless vary their bytes -- because one group spans several ANCHORS -- so the structural test alone would have promoted a pure bookkeeping record. This is the clearest reason the classification must be by intent as well as by structure.

_ERASE4.reason: zero-erase reachability probe over a 4-byte window; no varying group.

_L1_opcode_group.reason: rung 1 of the two-rung liveness ladder: ONE fixed mutation (byte0 xor 1) per anchor, used only to decide whether the anchor is live. Not a sweep; the 45/83 groups that 'vary' do so across anchors.

_L2_erase.reason: rung 2 of the same ladder -- zero the instruction and see whether anything moves. Single value, no group varies its bytes.

__2d_desc_lo.reason: 2-D sweep, 12 srcC_desc points x 11 srcC_lo points on imad; EXP-0160's verdicts.py:788 cites it as the evidence for the srcC split.

__2d_desc_mul.reason: 2-D sweep, 12 srcC_desc points x 8 mulsel points on imad; cited by EXP-0160/analysis/verdicts.py:808.

__baseline.reason: the unmutated anchor; 0 of 32 groups vary.

__dst_nibble.reason: 16-value sweep of byte0's high nibble on half_alu_ext8, value=n, one record per value, pre-registered hypothesis H0/DEF-0180-1 'destination GPR = byte0 bits 4..7'. This is the instance EXP-0189 found by hand.

__falsifier_F1_opsel_hadd.reason: pre-registered-to-fail: opsel -> hadd MUST change an fma result. Instrument check; 0 of 24 groups vary.

__falsifier_F2_srcA_zerolane.reason: pre-registered-to-fail: srcA -> the one lane that is 0.0 must move; 0 of 24 vary.

__falsifier_F3_dstnib_r7.reason: pre-registered-to-fail: byte0 high nibble -> 7 must move the write to r7. Same encoding position as __dst_nibble but a single fixed value used as an instrument check; 0 of 24 groups vary.

__falsifier_F4_zero_point.reason: the marker chain with no instruction in front of it -- the LEN instrument's zero point; 0 of 3 groups vary.

__falsifier_byte0.reason: pre-registered-to-fail byte0 mutation; 0 of 185 groups vary.

__ladder_L_b5.reason: a rung of the pre-registered LIVENESS LADDER: one mutation per rung, run to prove the arm can see a change at all before any inert verdict is allowed. The value is an encoding value, but the rung is an instrument check, not a sweep -- and NO ladder group varies its bytes, so the classification cannot change any number.

__len_b2.reason: 256-value sweep of byte+2 at six fixed byte+4 settings; value=b2 is the byte written. Observable is marker-chain survival (hardware instruction length), which is a real readback, but it is a LENGTH oracle, not a semantic one -- flagged on any field it restores.

__len_b4.reason: 256-value sweep of byte+4 at two fixed byte+2 settings; same length oracle as __len_b2.

__lut2d.reason: 2-D sweep of ilogic op_base x lut_a_sel x lut_b; the value is the packed tuple of the three encoding positions written. EXP-0154's own verdicts.py:450 reads these records as the ILOGIC measurement.

__raw_b0.reason: raw whole-byte sweep at byte index 0, value=v is the byte written, `byte_index` recorded on every case. Byte-level by construction; collect_raw's bit-exact path resolves it to whichever db fields the varying bits land in.

__raw_b2.reason: same generator as __raw_b0 at byte index 2.

__split_at0_r6.reason: single fixed-value structural split probe; 0 of 2 groups vary.

_b1_match.emitter: EXP-0184 raw record note: 'db.json models byte+1 as a FIXED MATCH CONSTANT (0xc2); EXP-0138 (M4) measured it LIVE. Detection-power control AND the G17P half of a db defect.'
_b1_match.reason: 256 distinct values of copysign byte+1 over 5 groups. The note calls it a detection-power control AND a db-defect measurement; it is a dense value sweep either way. Credits no db field (match bits).

_b2_match.emitter: EXP-0184 / EXP-0187 raw record note: 'modelled as a fixed match constant; swept for the G17P record'
_b2_match.reason: 256 distinct values of byte+2 over 12 groups; dense value sweep of an encoding position. Credits no db field.

_b3_match.emitter: EXP-0187 raw record note: 'fixed match constant in the pinned db; swept as a WHOLE-WORD liveness probe, never as a field'
_b3_match.reason: 16 distinct values of n4_rt_word byte+3 over 10 groups. The note disclaims FIELD status, and it is right that db exposes no field there -- so including it credits nothing, but it is a value sweep and is classified as one.

_baseline.reason: the unmutated anchor. 0 of 706 groups vary their bytes, by definition.

_baseline_final.reason: the anchor re-run at the end of a run; 0 of 454 groups vary.

_baseline_health.reason: periodic health check of the persistent runner; no bytes recorded.

_baseline_recheck.reason: the anchor re-run mid-sweep to detect drift; 0 of 370 groups vary.

_byte0.reason: the pre-registered-to-fail byte0 falsifier (0x55); one value per arm, 0 of 66 groups vary.

_byte0_hi.reason: 16-value sweep of half_alu byte0's high nibble with a host oracle and a pre-registered expectation (v==1 matches the anchor). Named with an underscore only because db.json models byte0 as a fixed match constant -- the same shape as __dst_nibble, one instruction earlier.

_byte1_11.reason: single fixed control value (0x11); records carry no bytes at all.

_byte2_56.reason: single fixed control value (0x56) on the ret_luse control arm; 0 of 4 vary.

_cascade_check.reason: DEF-0178-1 guard: re-run after a watchdog timeout to detect a manufactured hang cascade. An instrument, not a measurement.

_detect.emitter: EXP-0163/run.py:437-462 and EXP-0172/run.py:475 -- the DETECTION PROFILE loop
_detect.reason: for every db field of the anchor's descriptor it writes two values (the complement of the current value, and 0) and records whether the observation changed; outcome is 'moved'/'inert'. Structurally a per-field 2-value hardware sweep with bytes and observations -- 265 of 271 groups vary their bytes and they land in real db fields. But both experiments consume it ONLY as `arms_with_proven_detection_power`, i.e. as the instrument check that licences their inert verdicts, and two values chosen to maximise the chance of a change is not the dense sweep FIELD-SWEEP-PROTOCOL section 3 requires. Held out of the headline; reported as a declared sensitivity.

_detect_summary.reason: one per arm; carries the detection-power summary JSON in `note`. No bytes.

_falsifier_oracle.reason: pre-registered-to-fail oracle check; 0 of 18 groups vary.

_identity_splice.reason: splice the anchor back onto itself -- the null mutation; 0 of 20 groups vary.

_live_control.reason: the ladder-rung liveness control; value is the sentinel -1, and the record carries the rung description in `note`. 89 of 162 groups vary bytes across RUNGS, not across values of one position.

_liveness_dst_alt.reason: liveness control on an alternate destination; 0 of 8 groups vary.

_liveness_spatial.reason: spatial liveness control; 0 of 6 groups vary.

_liveness_src_alt.reason: liveness control on an alternate source; 0 of 14 groups vary.

_liveness_vp_alt.reason: viewport liveness control; 0 of 2 groups vary.

_match_b1.reason: 256-value sweep of copysign byte+1, value=v is the byte written. Declared a FALSIFIER/structure probe, but it is a dense value sweep of an encoding position; db models those bits as match constants, so it credits no db field.

_natural.reason: the natural, unspliced encoding of the liveness arm; single value, 0 of 3 vary.

_poscontrol.reason: positive control, value sentinel -1; 0 of 28 groups vary.

_rounding.reason: rounding-mode control case; 0 of 3 groups vary.

_sensitivity.reason: single-byte sensitivity control; 0 of 20 groups vary.

_smoke_store_shape.reason: smoke-run check of the store shape.

_start.reason: run-start marker; single record, no bytes.
